component.name: php-vitexsoftware-digest-renderer
component.summary: HTML rendering library for digest modules

description.p: DigestRenderer provides HTML rendering capabilities for digest analytics modules. It offers multiple themes including Bootstrap and Email themes for generating beautiful reports from accounting system data. Features: * Theme-based rendering system * Bootstrap theme for modern web interfaces * Email theme for notification systems * Module-specific renderers * Responsive HTML output * Easy theme customization
